subject: English
passage: In 1928, scientist Alexander Fleming first discovered penicillin when he noticed that a mold had contaminated one of his bacterial cultures and killed the surrounding bacteria. ______ in 1945, Fleming shared the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his revolutionary contribution to antibiotic development.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. "Later" logically signals that the event discussed in this sentence—Fleming receiving the Nobel Prize for his penicillin discovery—is a related event that occurred after the event discussed in the previous sentence (the 1928 discovery of penicillin).
